approve.effect: Records approval only; sent must be false. Never invokes an email sender.

authority: Same-origin partner session. The reference is an address, not a credential. The producer checks ownership and eligibility.
deployment_order: Producer deployed first. Live resolve-action-link discovery and synthetic not-found refusal verified before this app PR.

producer.pin_status: Final head, producer PR open at implementation start

reply.approval: submit-email-draft with exact proposal_id, base_version, subject, body, to, cc and retained idempotency_key. Authorizes sending; matching receipt confirms submission only.
reply.expiry: Lifecycle-based. Edited version, approval, dismissal or source retirement removes actionability. Never auto-retry.
